8. Photograph each defect, including wide shots and close-ups.
9. Include captions and scales in photographs for context and accuracy.
10. Cross-reference findings with the maintenance records and previous reports.
11. Summarize findings in a written report section.
12. Include recommendations for repair or further investigation.
13. Ensure all documentation adheres to relevant regulations and standards.
